THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES FOR VERICTO (vericto-cli)

The `vericto` binary in this release is built from the Rust crates listed
below. The list covers every crate compiled into the binary for the release
targets (build and development dependencies do not ship). After the list,
each license or notice file those crates carry appears once, with the crates
that carry it. The C code that the pg_query crate compiles into the binary
(libpg_query, PostgreSQL, protobuf-c and xxHash) is covered at the end of this
file. The Windows binary is built without the embedded engine, so the engine,
pg_query and their dependencies are not in it.

vericto-cli itself is licensed under the Functional Source License, Version
1.1, ALv2 Future License (FSL-1.1-ALv2); see LICENSE and NOTICE next to this
file. vericto-engine, which offline mode embeds, is Vericto's own code: its
entry below gives the license of the release this binary pins, and NOTICE
explains how Vericto licenses it as part of vericto-cli.

Generated by third-party/notices.py from Cargo.lock; do not edit by hand.
